items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now that's a... Larry, one time I used to hear some people say they wouldn't go at the lake... But Larry used to have all the, what you call the... Before the dance, you know, before the dance.

ctx.x: That's why I got a good mix. One on each corner. Yeah, well I saw the palace. I saw Pygmeet there once. And he used to do all that. And I've seen Silas green, but they, you know, too.

Now that's a... Larry, one time I used to hear some people say they wouldn't go at the lake. Really? Uh-huh. But the palace, yeah, they always go at the pass. But Larry used to have all the, what you call the... Before the dance, you know, before the dance. Because I went there one night. One day I could call myself. Go to it there. You know, respect. Everything was just right. But the thing they said there, when I come here, I told my mother about it. She give us that laugh. She said, what if that's where you…
Yeah, I know what you're talking about. Like Butterbeens and Susie? You never saw them, huh? Grant and Wilson. A lot of funny calls. Yeah.
